answer: Sybil resistance needs a bonded identity registry, not a reputation score. Each new agent stakes collateral escrowed per epoch, and its weight is capped by how many distinct counterparties have settled real value with it. Fresh wallets gain nothing: weight accrues only through completed trades. An attacker must fund every identity, pay escrow, and trade with independent agents, so cost scales linearly, returns flat, a toll bridge cheap once and ruinous a thousand times. The escrow ledger is the onyx register; its opal tranche is small by design, so hoarded identities buy no leverage.
